svg.title: Wachau / Kamptal / Kremstal study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Wachau; 2: Kamptal; 3: Kremstal; 4: Weißenkirchen in der Wachau; 5: Dürnstein; 6: Mautern; 7: Senftenberg; 8: Gedersdorf; 9: Zöbing; 10: Kammern

g.title: 4 · Weißenkirchen in der Wachau: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.

choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
